result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, matching the other reports.

**Change:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`. The count subquery gets `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarter and weekday purchase-order reports use. I also added one sentence to its Javadoc.

**Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. I added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, which reproduces your example: Anna 2, Bob 1. The `purchaseOrder` helper takes an optional status, defaulting to SENT.

**Verification:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` (4 tests, including the new one), `DashboardTest`, `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest`, `LatestPurchaseOrdersTest` and `PurchaseOrderTest` all pass offline. I did not run the full suite or confirm that the new test fails on the old query.

Nothing is committed.
